title: Claim State and Candidate Map Result Migration
negative_results: No result class carries MEASURED or REPLICATED evidence; a candidate is at most CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE (the evidence firewall as a table and as a guard in evidence_for).
A candidate result refuses to be serialized as measured: assert_not_measured() and to_serializable(as_measured=True) raise R1082ClaimError via claims.refuse_candidate_as_measured.

The legacy NO_UNIQUE_GEOGRAPHIC_DECODE refusal migrates into bounded CANDIDATE_CALIBRATED_POINT / CANDIDATE_REGION / CANDIDATE_ALIAS_SET / UNDERDETERMINED states, never inventing precision and never breaking the firewall.
A lone candidate without calibration falls to CANDIDATE_REGION, not a forced point; a missing CRS/epoch falls to CALIBRATION_REQUIRED.

claims.statement: The seven non-negotiable result classes are implemented as a deterministic state machine with per-class evidence classes and API error codes; candidate outputs are firewalled from measurement.
The R10.8.1 bare refusal is migrated into richer candidate states while preserving the evidence firewall (candidate never becomes MEASURED).
